Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3734); a cor, i.e. a specific measure:--measure.
BiblicalUsage: Koros is a cor, a measure for wheat. Luke 16:7 has the steward asking the debtor, how much owest thou, and the man answering, an hundred measures of wheat, and the steward saying, take thy bill, and write fourscore.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hundred measures are the whole parable in one number: a debt too big to pay, cut down by a steward too clever to be honest.
